naslov.en: The list of the fifth class.

lede.sr: Rad na prototipovima se nastavlja. Na spisku stoji 29 zapisa; 25 radova je fotografisano i objavljeno sa 75 fotografija. Kraj spiska čeka potvrdu studenata.
lede.en: The prototype work continues. The list carries 29 entries; 25 works were photographed and published with 75 photographs. The end of the list awaits the students’ confirmation.

description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak petog časa (30.10.2026), zapisivan redom vođenja; broj uz zapis je broj fotografija. Fotografije: telefon nastavnika, 11:44–14:08. Nastavnik je naveo da na kraju spiska verovatno nedostaje jedan zapis.
description.en: The teacher’s list of the fifth class (30 October 2026), recorded in the order it was kept; the number beside an entry is its photograph count. Photographs: the teacher’s phone, 11:44–14:08. The teacher noted that one entry is probably missing near the end of the list.

napomena.sr: Brojevi su brojevi fotografija, ne ocene. Zapisi bez objavljenih fotografija stoje niže, u delu „Šta se čeka”.
napomena.en: The numbers count photographs, not grades. Entries without published photographs stand below, in the „What we wait for” part.

presek.sr: Niz od 86 kadrova sa telefona podeljen je redom spiska, uz proveru pauza u snimanju i predmeta na kadru. Kraj niza (kadrovi 74–84) nije objavljen dok studenti ne potvrde ko je čiji rad.
presek.en: The sequence of 86 phone frames was cut in the order of the list, checked against the pauses in shooting and the object in the frame. The end of the sequence (frames 74–84) is not published until the students confirm whose work is whose.

analizaUdruzenja.sr: Spisak beleži četiri fotografije iz udruženja; u nizu sa telefona od 11:44 do 14:08 one nisu nađene, pa taj deo čeka prenos.
analizaUdruzenja.en: The list records four photographs from the association; they were not found in the phone sequence from 11:44 to 14:08, so that part awaits transfer.

sta.sr: Pred poslednja dva rada spiska verovatno nedostaje jedan zapis: kadrovi 74–84 (tri do četiri rada) čekaju da studenti potvrde autore. Četiri fotografije iz udruženja, zapisane na kraju spiska, nisu nađene u nizu.
sta.en: One entry is probably missing before the last two works of the list: frames 74–84 (three or four works) await the students’ confirmation of authorship. The four association photographs recorded at the end of the list were not found in the sequence.

sta.sr: Potvrđeni su važeći oblici imena zapisa 1 i 3 ovog spiska; isti oblici sada stoje i u spiskovima trećeg i četvrtog časa. Zapis 17 ovog spiska i zapis 30 trećeg časa su isti student: ime je ispravljeno, a indeks dopunjen.
sta.en: The valid name forms of entries 1 and 3 of this list are confirmed; the same forms now stand in the third- and fourth-class lists. Entry 17 of this list and entry 30 of the third class are the same student: the name is corrected and the student number added.
